title: Getting started
summary: Find your way around the studio, check your credits and open the live guide.

scenes.caption: Your credit balance
scenes.narration: Welcome to Vooads. Up here is your credit balance, so you always know what you can make today.

scenes.caption: Open the live guide
scenes.narration: If you ever feel lost, tap the guide. It walks you through the screen you are on, step by step.

scenes.caption: Start a new ad
scenes.narration: When you are ready to make something, tap Create.

scenes.caption: UGC talking video
scenes.narration: This is where you pick what to make. A UGC video is an AI presenter talking to camera about your product.

scenes.caption: Hooks and copy
scenes.narration: Hooks are the cheapest place to start. You get twenty opening lines to test before you spend on video.

scenes.caption: Everything you make lives here
scenes.narration: Everything you make shows up in your library, ready to download whenever you need it.

title: Your first UGC video
summary: Describe your product, pick a presenter, check the script and generate your first talking video.

scenes.caption: Choose UGC video
scenes.narration: Let's make your first talking video. Tap UGC video.

scenes.text: Lightweight sunscreen with no white cast, for daily wear
scenes.caption: Describe your product in one line
scenes.narration: Describe your product in one clear line. Say what it is and who it is for.

scenes.caption: Pick the language
scenes.narration: Pick the language your buyers speak. The script is written natively, so it does not sound translated.

scenes.caption: Choose a presenter
scenes.narration: Now choose a presenter. Pick someone who looks like the person you want to reach.

scenes.caption: Set the length
scenes.narration: Fifteen seconds is a great first test. Short ads are cheaper and easier to compare.

scenes.caption: Let AI write the script
scenes.narration: Turn on the AI script and Vooads writes a hook, the middle and a call to action for you.

scenes.caption: Read and edit the script
scenes.narration: Read it through. Change any line you like before you spend credits on the video.

scenes.caption: Generate
scenes.narration: Happy with it? Hit generate. Your video lands in the library in a few minutes.

title: Long videos
summary: Make 30 to 90 second videos. See how parts are stitched and how to write lines that cut cleanly.

scenes.caption: Pick a longer length
scenes.narration: Some products need more time to explain. Pick a longer length here, up to what your plan allows.

scenes.caption: Parts are stitched for you
scenes.narration: Long videos are made in short parts and stitched together automatically. This note shows how many parts yours will have.

scenes.text: Here is the part I did not expect.
scenes.caption: Write lines that end cleanly
scenes.narration: Keep each line to one complete thought. Short lines make the joins between parts feel smooth.

scenes.caption: Ban Shield checks every line
scenes.narration: Ban Shield checks the whole script as you go, so a risky phrase does not slip in at second forty.

scenes.caption: Generate the long video
scenes.narration: Credits are taken up front. If a render fails, you get every credit back.

scenes.caption: One finished video
scenes.narration: When it is done, you get one finished video in your library, with the same presenter and voice all the way through.

title: Languages and geos
summary: Take a winning ad into new markets with native scripts, local currency and the right presenter.

scenes.caption: Find your winner
scenes.narration: Start with an ad that already works. Filter your library to find it.

scenes.text: Same sunscreen, price R199, for South Africa
scenes.caption: Add local details
scenes.narration: Add the local price and market to your product line. Real local details make the ad feel native.

scenes.caption: Choose the new language
scenes.narration: Pick the new language. Vooads rewrites the script for that market instead of translating it word for word.

scenes.caption: Match the presenter to the market
scenes.narration: Choose a presenter who fits the new market. It is one of the biggest levers you have.

scenes.caption: Keep the winning angle
scenes.narration: Keep the same angle and structure as your winner. Change the words, the currency and the references.

scenes.caption: Generate the local version
scenes.narration: Generate, and you have a local version ready to test next to the original.

title: Ban Shield
summary: Check your copy for wording that often gets ads rejected, and fix it in one click.

scenes.text: Make $500 a day with this trading app, guaranteed.
scenes.caption: Paste your copy
scenes.narration: Paste any ad copy or script here. Let's try a line that would get flagged.

scenes.caption: Run the check
scenes.narration: Tap check. Ban Shield looks for income claims, health claims, personal attributes and other common rejection reasons.

scenes.caption: See what is risky
scenes.narration: Here it flags the income claim and the guarantee. Both are common reasons finance ads get rejected.

scenes.caption: Get a safer version
scenes.narration: Tap fix to get a safer rewrite that keeps your angle.

scenes.caption: It runs on every script
scenes.narration: Ban Shield also runs on every script you generate. It lowers your risk, but the platforms always make the final call.

title: Credits and plans
summary: How credits work, which plan fits you, how to top up and how to use a discount code.

scenes.caption: Open your wallet
scenes.narration: Tap your balance to open the wallet. Everything about credits and billing lives here.

scenes.caption: Compare plans
scenes.narration: Every plan gives you monthly credits. Bigger plans give more credits, longer videos and AI scripts from Pro upwards.

scenes.caption: Top up any time
scenes.narration: Running low mid-week? Top up. Top-up credits do not expire, and plan credits are used first.

scenes.caption: Apply a discount code
scenes.narration: Got a code from an email? Type it here before you pay.

scenes.caption: Pick and pay
scenes.narration: Choose a plan and pay by card, a local method or crypto, depending on what is available where you are.

title: Support and tickets
summary: Open a ticket, describe the problem clearly and request a callback when you need one.

scenes.caption: Open a new ticket
scenes.narration: Need help? Open a new ticket. A real person on our team reads every one.

scenes.caption: Write a clear subject
scenes.narration: Give it a short, clear subject. It helps us route it to the right person fast.

scenes.caption: Send it
scenes.narration: Send it. You get instant help articles that might solve it right away, plus our expected reply time.

scenes.caption: Ask for a callback
scenes.narration: Prefer to talk? Request a callback and pick a time that suits you.

scenes.caption: Replies arrive by email too
scenes.narration: When we reply, you get an email as well, so you never have to keep this page open.

title: Scaling a winner
summary: Turn one winning ad into fresh hooks, new presenters, slideshows and new geos before it fatigues.

scenes.caption: Find the winner
scenes.narration: Every winner fatigues. The trick is to replace it before it does. Start by finding it in your library.

scenes.caption: Write new hooks for it
scenes.narration: First, write twenty new hooks for the same product and angle. Keep the angle, change the opening.

scenes.text: Same product, same angle: saves 10 minutes every morning
scenes.caption: Keep the winning angle
scenes.narration: Name the winning angle in your product line, so every hook builds on what already works.

scenes.caption: Try new presenters
scenes.narration: Pick your three best hooks and try them with two or three new presenters.

scenes.caption: Add a slideshow version
scenes.narration: Make a slideshow version too. It is a cheap way to test the same idea in a different format.

scenes.caption: Take it to the next geo
scenes.narration: Then take the winner into your next language or market.

scenes.caption: Download and launch
scenes.narration: Download the batch and launch it next to your winner. Let the data pick what stays.

title: Referrals and brand settings
summary: Save your brand details once, and share your referral link to earn commission.

scenes.caption: Add your brand
scenes.narration: Add your brand name once in settings, so every script uses it the same way.

scenes.caption: Save
scenes.narration: Save it, and you are done.

scenes.caption: Your referral link
scenes.narration: This is your referral link. When someone you refer pays, you earn a commission.

scenes.caption: Copy and share
scenes.narration: Copy it and share it with other media buyers. Honest recommendations only, please.

scenes.caption: The guide is always here
scenes.narration: And remember, the live guide is always one tap away if you need it.
